sources.snippet: Saraswathy Amjith MIT '27 · Computer Science & Mathematics I'm an undergraduate researcher at MIT CSAIL working on language model reasoning, adversarial self-play, and in-context learning. My research focuses on teaching LLMs to recover from flawed reasoning and adapt to novel domains without fine-tuning.
